source.derivative: One continuous source interval [30,150) seconds, FFmpeg scale 1920x1080 to 768x432, H.264 libx264 fast CRF18 yuv420p, audio removed, faststart. No loops, frame synthesis, reordered shots, or model-generated content.
source.review: Full upstream timeline and the final derivative were visually reviewed before inference. Opening shots show a male driver holding a phone to his ear and later drinking/rubbing his head. The final shot shows a female driver and a male passenger. Review images remain external evidence.

client_contract.input: video_url followed by the frozen text question
client_contract.frame_selection: ABSENT; historical default eight-frame uniform path
client_contract.advanced_client_controls: none; no policy, budget, prefix, or scheduling field
client_contract.voice_response: modalities=[text,audio], audio={voice:vivian,format:wav,stream:true}; wav is the required request envelope while streaming output is audio/pcm; this is not a frame/scheduler control

cases.question: What does the man driving in the opening shot do with his phone? Answer in one short sentence.
cases.canonical_answer: He holds the phone to his ear to make a call.

cases.question: How does the driver change between the opening shot and the final shot? Answer in one short sentence.
cases.canonical_answer: A woman replaces a man as the driver in the final shot.

execution.prefix_cache: disabled; every VLM request must log prefix_reused=0
execution.case_order: seeded interleaving with seed 510075 and identical schedule per stack
execution.cleanup: SIGTERM only recorded task-owned stage/gateway PIDs; require in_flight=0 and GPU1 zero compute processes

metrics.first_public_text_ms: first nonempty public text delta from request start
metrics.first_public_voice_ms: first public audio/pcm artifact chunk from request start
metrics.quality: casefolded expect_all plus optional expect_any rule; every measured raw answer and miss retained
metrics.distributions: median, nearest-rank p95, inclusive IQR, MAD, mean, CV, min/max; retain all outliers
metrics.paired: candidate-minus-baseline by ABBA half, case and repetition; exact two-sided sign test and 20000 deterministic median-bootstrap resamples, seed 510075
metrics.voice_pcm: base64/chunk order/byte count/SHA-256 validated and exact across each baseline/candidate pair

acceptance.ns05_response: All measured first text and first voice p95 values must be below 3000 ms; failures remain visible even if another metric improves.
acceptance.promotion: Require negative median paired first-voice delta, bootstrap 95 percent upper bound below zero, exact sign-test p<=0.05, no TTFT/TTFA/decode-prefill median or p95 regression greater than 1 percent, exact answer/native/PCM parity, and unchanged Task72 controls.
acceptance.no_gain_or_unavailable_golden_run: Remove the parallel second-resize candidate from final default runtime and mark NOT_PROMOTED. Preserve historical diagnostics and do not tune another optimization.
acceptance.quality: Report exact hits/misses per implementation/case; no prompt or alias changes after answers and no generalized/perceptual-quality claim.
